evidence: Current Rust/source and local Windows 0.62.2 public API definitions read, edited and manually reviewed only. No builds, tests, syntax checks, project/game/module/renderer/JNI/shader/GPU execution, process inspection, native API calls, account actions or exports. Runtime parity remains unverified by user instruction.

source.hooks: Extend the existing actual-device observer with base CreateDescriptorHeap, CreateConstantBufferView, CreateShaderResourceView, CreateUnorderedAccessView and CreateSampler. Query optional Device11.CreateSampler2 and Device8.CreateSamplerFeedbackUnorderedAccessView; only E_NOINTERFACE means absent. Publish exact public-ABI trampolines before enablement. A same-target/same-ABI sampler alias uses the base pointer-presence observer; other ambiguous aliases fail installation. Activate descriptor provenance only after every observer enables successfully.
source.deviceScope: Retain and canonicalize the first fully hooked actual device. Descriptor provenance is admitted only for that device; a recent/similar device is not substituted. Queries use actual API objects/results and canonical numeric identities, never a copied registry address. Other-device observation failures conservatively invalidate knowledge rather than manufacture coverage.
source.heaps: Successful actual heap outputs supply held typed heap/device references, unique monotonic heap IDs, immutable type/count/stride and actual CPU/GPU starts. Track CPU staging and shader-visible resource/sampler heaps. Key slots by heap ID and index; eviction removes that heap's entries and cannot reuse an old identity. A copied handle alone never creates a heap or invokes COM.
source.viewObjects: Observed SRV/UAV calls retain their actual non-null resource arguments, including UAV counter objects. Optional feedback views retain both actual inputs. Actual device/description/heap properties and queried allocation sizes bound resource retention. Ordinary null resource views with supported explicit descriptions need no resource owner. Ray-tracing acceleration SRVs, unsupported dimensions/descriptions and unqueryable/oversized resources remain unknown.
source.constantBuffers: CBV descriptions retain actual aligned location/size facts through the existing committed-buffer span resolver; location zero needs no allocation. No GPU address is dereferenced as CPU/COM memory. Missing committed coverage retains an unknown backing-allocation result; null/invalid CBV descriptions remain unknown.
source.samplers: Base and extended sampler callbacks record their actual creation-call provenance and sampler slot type. Samplers reference no resource arguments. This does not copy or validate sampler parameters or attest driver descriptor contents.
source.copies: Existing bounded CopyDescriptors/CopyDescriptorsSimple expansion now also feeds resource/sampler metadata before and after the unchanged driver call. Snapshot source values/revisions first; invalidate destinations while pending. Non-shader-visible sources, equal bounded counts, nonoverlapping source/destination slots and unique destinations are required. Unknown source values remain unknown; changed known source revisions prevent publication.
source.overlap: Every admitted operation has a monotonic token and per-slot active tokens. Overlapping writes to a destination leave it unknown through every completion, irrespective of return order. A later uncontested write can reestablish its value. Cache reset/overflow or a failed query holds global uncertainty until all in-flight operations drain; it never guesses that the last returning or last starting operation won.
source.failureAndDisable: Query/observation failure gets an uncertain-write guard before the original API call so old slots cannot remain falsely known. Abandoned guards invalidate and release their admission count. Observer unwinding is contained; poisoned/exhausted state cannot attest ownership. Disabled external writes clear metadata immediately, in addition to frame-time collection, so off/on between frames cannot revive stale values.
source.retention: Snapshot.capture consumes the actual graphics/compute slot plan under one metadata lock. Actual heap identity, type, slot extent, stride and CPU/GPU handle facts must agree. Every selected slot must have a known matching kind and no pending write. The cohort retains heap/value Arcs, actual resource COM objects and any matching committed allocation owners. It distinguishes retained objects from complete backing-allocation ownership.
source.transaction: Graphics-state Snapshot stores the descriptor cohort and clones it into the existing native draw-asset Owners before commands. Snapshot.matches also rejects a changed known descriptor revision before emission. Normal binding restoration remains unchanged even if metadata later changes; it must still run. Heap/value discovery eviction cannot drop a retained snapshot's objects. Existing list-generation/non-replayability/private-fence retirement governs eventual transaction release.
source.locks: COM queries occur outside the descriptor-cache mutex. Removed heaps, entries/maps and values move to a Retired holder and are released after unlocking. Arc clones/partial-query drops under the lock cannot destroy objects while originals remain held by the locked cache or retirement holder. Write guards are declared outside the lock scope so abandonment cannot recursively lock it during unwinding.

bounds.charging: Canonical resource identities deduplicate aliases; sizes use the maximum observed query per identity. Caps describe discovery metadata/queried allocation bytes, not all driver/native heap overhead or separately retained frame/transaction pools.

source.diagnostics: Native queue status now includes bounded heap/slot/inflight/conflict/invalidation counts and maximum resource/reference limits, with no object/handle addresses. Source recording status distinguishes public write tracking and retained descriptor resources from a complete descriptor-content owner.

remaining: No descriptor bytes are read, copied or frozen; void API calls do not prove driver validation. Revision stability before emission cannot reserve slots against later CPU/GPU-visible reuse. Exclusive native phase/descriptor ownership is still required.

Referenced resource COM ownership does not lease placed/reserved/native allocator suballocations. Allocation completeness remains false where committed creation was not observed, shader textures are outside current committed discovery, or buffer/node provenance is unknown.
Unobserved/evicted heap history, direct indexing and oversized/unknown root spans remain unknown. The first-device hook model still needs an explicit device-recreation/rebinding contract.

Authoritative live Java-equivalent material/phase inputs and a game-facing insertion caller remain missing; complete live cosmetics/capes/emotes/replays, deterministic video export and full parity remain unfinished.
Build, hook/overlap/query-failure/copy/disable/retirement comparisons and live rendering/export verification. No test cases were added or executed.
